muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿حم﴾: The discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز العليم﴾: ﴿تنزيل الكتاب﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and ﴿العزيز العليم﴾ are two attributes (ṣifatān).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿غافر الذنب وقابل التوب شديد العقاب ذي الطول﴾: attributes of the Divine Name in the previous verse.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation (lā al-nāfiya li-l-jins).
﴿إله﴾: its ism (noun), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of لا together with its ism, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal from the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿إليه المصير﴾: ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar; and ﴿المصير﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ما يجادل في آيات الله إلا الذين كفروا﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿يجادل﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿في آيات الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادل﴾; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿الذين﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿كفروا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا يغررك تقلبهم في البلاد﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); ﴿يغررك﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿تقلبهم﴾ is the fāʿil; and ﴿في البلاد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقلبهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح والأحزاب من بعدهم﴾: ﴿كذبت﴾ is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; ﴿قبلهم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿قوم نوح﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿الأحزاب﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿قوم نوح﴾; and ﴿من بعدهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وهمت كل أمة برسولهم ليأخذوه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿همت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿كذبت﴾; ﴿كل أمة﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿برسولهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿همت﴾; the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); ﴿يأخذوه﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿همت﴾.
﴿وجادلوا بالباطل ليدحضوا به الحق فأخذتهم فكيف كان عقاب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿جادلوا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and it is conjoined to ﴿همت﴾; ﴿بالباطل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, or attached to ﴿جادلوا﴾; ﴿ليدحضوا﴾: the lām is for cause, and ﴿يدحضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جادلوا﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدحضوا﴾; ﴿الحق﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فأخذتهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جادلوا﴾; ﴿فكيف﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ﴿كيف﴾ is an interrogative noun, in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; and ﴿عقاب﴾ is the ism (noun) of كان, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the first person.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وكذلك حقت كلمت ربك على الذين كفروا أنهم أصحاب النار﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an attribute (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing word; or in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and the matter is like that"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿كلمة ربك﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿على الذين كفروا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حقت﴾; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنهم أصحاب النار﴾ is a nominative badal (substitute) from ﴿كلمة ربك﴾, or in [the position of] accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), that preposition being the lām of cause [Translator's note: the source reads «أو في منصوب», apparently a slip for «أو في محل نصب» or «أو منصوب»].

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿الذين يحملون العرش ومن حوله يسبحون بحمد ربهم ويؤمنون به﴾: ﴿الذين﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يحملون﴾ is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and العرش is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يحملون العرش﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun in the position of nominative, conjoined to the mubtadaʾ; ﴿حوله﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿يسبحون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿بحمد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by praise"; ﴿ربهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يسبحون بحمد ربهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; and ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿يسبحون﴾.
﴿ويستغفرون للذين آمنوا ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمة وعلما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿يستغفرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستغفرون﴾; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and it is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿ربنا﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, from which the vocative particle has been omitted, and the vocative clause is the object of an omitted saying, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "saying"; ﴿وسعت﴾ is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; ﴿كل شيء﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿رحمة وعلمًا﴾ are two tamyīz (specification) [accusatives], and the tamyīz here is converted from the fāʿil, i.e. "Your mercy encompasses everything, and Your knowledge encompasses everything".
﴿فاغفر للذين تابوا واتبعوا سبيلك﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿اغفر﴾ is a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اغفر﴾; the clause ﴿تابوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿اتبعوا سبيلك﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and سبيلك is mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is conjoined to ﴿للذين تابوا﴾.
﴿وقهم عذاب الجحيم﴾: ﴿قِ﴾ is a verb of supplication, mabnī (indeclinable) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿عذاب الجحيم﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ربنا وأدخلهم جنات عدن التي وعدتهم ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم﴾: ﴿ربنا﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿أدخلهم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded, and ﴿أدخلهم﴾ is a verb of supplication, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت", and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿جنات عدن﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi, by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); ﴿التي﴾ is an attribute (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿وعدتهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object of ﴿أدخلهم﴾ or to the object of ﴿وعدتهم﴾; the clause ﴿صلح﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿من آبائهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿أزواجهم وذرياتهم﴾ are conjoined to ﴿آبائهم﴾.
﴿إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its ism (noun); ﴿أنت﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and العزيز الحكيم are two predicates (khabarān) of ﴿أنت﴾, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿إنك﴾; or ﴿أنت﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and ﴿العزيز الحكيم﴾ are two predicates of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وقهم السيئات ومن تق السيئات يومئذ فقد رحمته﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قهم﴾ is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿هم﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿السيئات﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿تق﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; ﴿السيئات﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقِ﴾, and إذٍ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "on the day when he is taken to account for them". ﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿أخزيته﴾ is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse here reads ﴿فقد رحمته﴾, and «أخزيته» appears to be carried over from a similar verse (Āl ʿImrān 3:192); the analysis applies equally to رحمته].
﴿وذلك هو الفوز العظيم﴾: ﴿ذلك﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿هو﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ; and ﴿الفوز العظيم﴾ are two predicates (khabarān) of ﴿هو﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and ﴿الفوز العظيم﴾ are two predicates of ﴿ذلك﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا ينادون لمقت الله أكبر من مقتكم أنفسكم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿الذين﴾ is its ism (noun); ﴿كفروا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ينادون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿ينادون﴾ is an imperfect verb, passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); ﴿مقت الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the annexation being of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its agent, while the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. "you (إياكم)"; ﴿أكبر﴾ is the khabar; ﴿من مقتكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أكبر﴾; and ﴿أنفسكم﴾ is the object of ﴿مقتكم﴾.
﴿إذ تدعون إلى الإيمان فتكفرون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "He detested you when you were called", or: "remember when you were called"; the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿تدعون﴾ is an imperfect verb, passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; ﴿إلى الإيمان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تدعون﴾; ﴿فتكفرون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ﴿تكفرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قالوا ربنا أمتنا اثنتين وأحييتنا اثنتين فاعترفنا بذنوبنا فهل إلى خروج من سبيل﴾: ﴿قالوا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ربنا﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿أمتنا﴾ is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil, and ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿اثنتين﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its number; ﴿أحييتنا اثنتين﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أمتنا اثنتين﴾; ﴿اعترفنا﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿بذنوبنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اعترفنا﴾; ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle; ﴿إلى خروج﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; and ﴿سبيل﴾ is genitive in form and nominative in position, as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ذلكم بأنه إذا دعي الله وحده كفرتم﴾: ﴿ذلكم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بأنه﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun); ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; ﴿دعي﴾ is a past verb, passive; ﴿الله﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿دعي﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿وحده﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿كفرتم﴾ is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفرتم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿إذا﴾; the conditional clause and its answer are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أنه﴾; and the clause ﴿بأنه...﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿وإن يشرك به تؤمنوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿يشرك﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), and it is an imperfect verb, passive; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word] that takes the place of the nāʾib fāʿil; and ﴿تؤمنوا﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿فالحكم لله العلي الكبير﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿الحكم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; and ﴿العلي الكبير﴾ are two attributes (ṣifatān).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿هو الذي يريكم آياته وينزل لكم من السماء رزقا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿يريكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يريكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿آياته﴾ is mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with kasra; ﴿ينزل﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, the fāʿil is latent, and it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يريكم﴾; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينزل﴾; and ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينزل﴾.
﴿وما يتذكر إلا من ينيب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿يتذكر﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿ينيب﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent; and the clause ﴿ينيب﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿فادعوا الله مخلصين له الدين ولو كره الكافرون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿ادعوا﴾ is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the Divine Name is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿مخلصين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مخلصين﴾; ﴿الدين﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿كره الكافرون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e. "your sincerity", or: "your calling [upon Him]".

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿رفيع الدرجات ذو العرش يلقي الروح من أمره على من يشاء من عباده لينذر يوم التلاق﴾: ﴿رفيع الدرجات﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ذو العرش﴾ is a second khabar; ﴿يلقي الروح﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿الروح﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is a third khabar; ﴿من أمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يلقي﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الروح﴾, i.e. "in the state of its arising from His command"; ﴿على من﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يلقي﴾; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿من عباده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿لينذر﴾: the lām is for cause (taʿlīl), and ﴿ينذر﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يلقي﴾; the fāʿil is "هو": Allah, or the Spirit (الروح), or whomever He wills; ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿ينذر﴾; and ﴿التلاق﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿يوم هم بارزون لا يخفى على الله منهم شيء﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿يوم التلاق﴾, a badal of the whole for the whole; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بارزون﴾ is the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of genitive by the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يخفى﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخفى﴾; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an attribute of ﴿شيء﴾; ﴿شيء﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يخفى﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يخفى ...﴾ is a ḥāl from the pronoun of ﴿بارزون﴾, or a second khabar; and it was said: it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لمن الملك اليوم لله الواحد القهار﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. He the Exalted says it and answers Himself; the saying is conjoined to what precedes it, or it is resumptive, in answer to an implied question, as if it were asked: "So what will happen then?", and it was said: "It will be said: To whom belongs the dominion…?"; ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ﴿الملك﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to ﴿الملك﴾; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "the dominion is Allah's"; and ﴿الواحد القهار﴾ are two naʿts (adjectives) of الله.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿اليوم تجزى كل نفس بما كسبت﴾: ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجزى﴾, and the speech is a continuation of what is said; ﴿تجزى﴾ is an imperfect verb, passive; ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجزى﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ is relative or adverbial (ẓarfiyya); ﴿كسبت﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and the clause ﴿كسبت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا ظلم اليوم إن الله سريع الحساب﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation (lā al-nāfiya li-l-jins); ﴿ظلم﴾ is its ism (noun), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Divine Name is its ism, and ﴿سريع الحساب﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وأنذرهم يوم الآزفة إذ القلوب لدى الحناجر كاظمين﴾: the wāw conjoins to what preceded; ﴿أنذرهم﴾ is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿هم﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يوم الآزفة﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿يوم الآزفة﴾; ﴿القلوب﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لدى الحناجر﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿كاظمين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿القلوب﴾.
﴿ما للظالمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع﴾: the clause is a ḥāl from the owners of the hearts; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿للظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿حميم﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿من﴾; ﴿لا شفيع﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿حميم﴾; ﴿يطاع﴾ is an imperfect verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; and the clause ﴿يطاع﴾ is an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿شفيع﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿يعلم خائنة الأعين وما تخفي الصدور﴾: the clause is a fourth khabar (predicate) of the omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose predicate is ﴿رفيع الدرجات﴾ and what follows it; or it is one of the predicates of ﴿هو الذي يريكم﴾; or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or it is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah the Exalted; ﴿خائنة الأعين﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the annexation having the sense of "من" (of), i.e. "the treacherous among the eyes"; on this view ﴿خائنة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted noun, i.e. "the treacherous eye"; or ﴿خائنة﴾ is a maṣdar (verbal noun), like العاقبة and الكاذبة, i.e. "He knows the treachery of the eyes"; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿خائنة الأعين﴾; and the clause ﴿تخفي الصدور﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿والله يقضي بالحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يقضي: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "هو"; the clause يقضي is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقضي﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in accordance with it".
﴿والذين يدعون من دونه لا يقضون بشيء﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿الذين﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿يدعون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعون﴾; the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "they call upon them besides Him", meaning: they worship them; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يقضون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿بشيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقضي﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in this clause is ﴿يقضون﴾]; and the clause ﴿لا يقضون بشيء﴾ is the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾.
﴿إن الله هو السميع البصير﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿الله﴾ is its ism (noun); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿السميع البصير﴾ are two predicates (khabarān) of ﴿هو﴾, and the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿السميع البصير﴾ are two predicates of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿أولم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين كانوا من قبلهم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw is conjunctive, conjoining to something implied (muqaddar) that the context requires, i.e. "Were they heedless and did not travel?"; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; ﴿يسيروا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسيروا﴾; ﴿فينظروا﴾: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya) or conjunctive, and ﴿ينظروا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the causal fāʾ, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar (verbal noun) taken from the preceding speech, the implied form being: "Was there not travelling, so that there would be looking?"; or it is jussive, conjoined to ﴿يسيروا﴾; ﴿كيف﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿عاقبة﴾ is its ism (noun); and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿ينظروا﴾; ﴿كانوا﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its ism; ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿كانوا﴾; and the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿كانوا هم أشد منهم قوة وآثارا في الأرض﴾: ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its ism; ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; ﴿أشد﴾ is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشد﴾; ﴿قوة﴾ is a tamyīz (specification); ﴿آثارًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قوة﴾; and ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿آثارًا﴾.
﴿فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿أخذهم﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿هم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بذنوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخذهم﴾, and the bāʾ is causal, i.e. because of their sins.
﴿وما كان لهم من الله من واق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿واق﴾; ﴿من﴾ is a connective particle (ḥarf ṣila); and ﴿واق﴾ is genitive in form and nominative in position, as the postponed ism of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم كانت تأتيهم رسلهم بالبينات﴾: ﴿ذلك﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the bāʾ is a preposition of causation; ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its ism (noun); anna together with what it governs is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ذلك﴾; ﴿كانت﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb; ﴿تأتيهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and ﴿هم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿رسلهم﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تأتيهم﴾ is the khabar of ﴿كانت﴾, whose ism is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: hiya; the clause ﴿كانت﴾ is the khabar of ﴿أن﴾; and ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأتيهم﴾.
﴿فكفروا فأخذهم الله﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿كفروا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to ﴿تأتيهم﴾; ﴿فأخذهم الله﴾ is a verb, mafʿūl bihi and fāʿil, and it is conjoined to His words ﴿فكفروا﴾.
﴿إنه قوي شديد العقاب﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its ism; ﴿قوي﴾ is a first khabar; and ﴿شديد العقاب﴾ is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا وسلطان مبين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿موسى﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ولقد أرسلنا موسى﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿بآياتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. invested with ﴿آياتنا﴾; ﴿سلطان﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بآياتنا﴾; and ﴿مبين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿إلى فرعون وهامان وقارون فقالوا ساحر كذاب﴾: ﴿إلى فرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; ﴿هامان وقارون﴾ are conjoined to ﴿فرعون﴾; ﴿فقالوا﴾ is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and it is conjoined to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; and ﴿ساحر كذاب﴾ are two khabars (predicates) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is a magician, a liar."

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فلما جاءهم بالحق من عندنا قالوا اقتلوا أبناء الذين آمنوا معه واستحيوا نساءهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿لما﴾ is temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking particle (rābiṭa ḥarfiyya); ﴿جاءهم﴾ is a past verb, ﴿هم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾; ﴿من عندنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿قالوا﴾ is a past verb and fāʿil, and the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive conditional, namely ﴿لما﴾; ﴿اقتلوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); ﴿أبناء الذين﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb of place, attached to ﴿آمنوا﴾; the clause ﴿فلما جاءهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and ﴿استحيوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اقتلوا﴾.
﴿وما كيد الكافرين إلا في ضلال﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كيد الكافرين﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كيد﴾.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وقال فرعون ذروني أقتل موسى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال فرعون﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿ذروني﴾ is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); ﴿أقتل﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: anā, referring back to the speaker.
﴿وليدع ربه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is the lām of command; ﴿يدع﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, and the fāʿil is latent; and ﴿ربه﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إني أخاف أن يبدل دينكم﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun); ﴿أخاف﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿أن﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; ﴿يبدل﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾, and the fāʿil is latent; and ﴿دينكم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أو أن يظهر في الأرض الفساد﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿أن يظهر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أن يبدل﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يظهر﴾; and ﴿الفساد﴾ is the object of ﴿يظهر﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وقال موسى إني عذت بربي وربكم من كل متكبر لا يؤمن بيوم الحساب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; ﴿موسى﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun); ﴿عذت﴾ is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿عذت﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); ﴿من كل متكبر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عذت﴾; the clause ﴿لا يؤمن﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿متكبر﴾; and ﴿بيوم الحساب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وقال رجل مؤمن من آل فرعون يكتم إيمانه﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿قال رجل﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿مؤمن﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجل﴾; ﴿من آل فرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second naʿt if the man was a Copt, the implied form being: "And a believing man, belonging to the family of Pharaoh, said"; but if the man was an Israelite, then the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يكتم﴾, in the position of the second object of ﴿يكتم﴾; and the clause ﴿يكتم إيمانه﴾ is a third attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿رجل﴾.
﴿أتقتلون رجلًا أن يقول ربي الله﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); ﴿تقتلون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿رجلًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; ﴿يقول﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); and an together with what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. on account of this saying, without reflection, consideration or contemplation; and it is said: it is an adverb (ẓarf) on the assumption of an implied muḍāf, i.e. "at the time that he says"; ﴿ربي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿الله﴾ its khabar (predicate), or the reverse; and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
﴿وقد جاءكم بالبينات من ربكم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿جاءكم﴾ is a past verb, the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: huwa, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءكم﴾; and ﴿من ربكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإن يك كاذبًا فعليه كذبه وإن يك صادقًا يصبكم بعض الذي يعدكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿يك﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was dropped for lightening, and it is an incomplete, abrogating imperfect verb (one of kāna and its sisters), whose ism (noun) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: huwa; ﴿كاذبًا﴾ is its khabar; ﴿فعليه﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ﴿كذبه﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the clause ﴿إن يك صادقًا يصبكم بعض الذي يعدكم﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause; ﴿يصبكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بعض﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿يصبكم﴾; and the clause ﴿يعدكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله لا يهدي من هو مسرف كذاب﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Divine Name is its ism; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يهدي﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, ﴿مسرف﴾ a khabar, and ﴿كذاب﴾ a second khabar; the clause ﴿هو مسرف﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿لا يهدي من...﴾ is the khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿يا قوم لكم الملك اليوم ظاهرين في الأرض﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿قوم﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿الملك﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to what the khabar is attached to; ﴿ظاهرين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿لكم﴾; and ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظاهرين﴾.
﴿فمن ينصرنا من بأس الله إن جاءنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿من﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; ﴿ينصرنا﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), ﴿نا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿ينصرنا﴾ is the khabar; ﴿من بأس الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينصرنا﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿جاءنا﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then who will help us?"; and the fāʿil of ﴿جاءنا﴾ refers back to ﴿بأس الله﴾.
﴿قال فرعون ما أريكم إلا ما أرى﴾: ﴿قال فرعون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿أريكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being: anā, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second object of ﴿أريكم﴾; and the clause ﴿أرى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما أهديكم إلا سبيل الرشاد﴾: conjoined to what preceded; and ﴿سبيل الرشاد﴾ is the second object of ﴿أهديكم﴾, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وقال الذي آمن يا قوم إني أخاف عليكم مثل يوم الأحزاب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; ﴿الذي﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿آمن﴾ is a past verb, and the clause ﴿آمن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿قوم﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun); the clause ﴿أخاف﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخاف﴾; ﴿مثل﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿يوم الأحزاب﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿مثل دأب قوم نوح وعاد وثمود والذين من بعدهم﴾: ﴿مثل﴾ is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), or a badal (substitute) for ﴿مثل﴾ in the previous verse; ﴿دأب﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and an omitted muḍāf must be assumed, i.e. "like the recompense and the custom of those who disbelieved before you, namely their punishment in this world"; ﴿وعاد وثمود والذين من بعدهم﴾ is conjoined to what preceded; ﴿من بعدهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. And the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما الله يريد ظلما للعباد﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa, the Divine Name is the ism (noun) of mā, and the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of mā; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-operative negating particle, the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿ظلمًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿للعباد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظلمًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿ويا قوم إني أخاف عليكم يوم التناد﴾: conjoined to ﴿إني أخاف﴾; ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿قوم﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun); the clause ﴿أخاف﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخاف﴾; and ﴿يوم التناد﴾ is the object of ﴿أخاف﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿يوم تولون مدبرين ما لكم من الله من عاصم﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is a badal (substitute) from the first yawm; the clause ﴿تولون﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb's annexation to it; ﴿مدبرين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عاصم﴾; ﴿من عاصم﴾: ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿عاصم﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾; and the clause ﴿ما لكم من الله من عاصم﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as the fronted object of ﴿يضلل﴾; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ﴿مِن﴾ is a connective preposition; and ﴿هاد﴾ is a noun, genitive in form and nominative in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿ومن يضلل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولقد جاءكم يوسف من قبل بالبينات﴾: speech conjoined to what preceded; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿جاءكم﴾ is a past verb, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يوسف﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. before Moses; and ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءكم﴾.
﴿فما زلتم في شك مما جاءكم به﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿ما زلتم﴾ is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the tāʾ is its ism (noun); ﴿في شك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿شك﴾; the clause ﴿جاءكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءكم﴾.
﴿حتى إذا هلك قلتم لن يبعث الله من بعده رسولا﴾: ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit (ghāya) for His words ﴿ما زلتم﴾; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿هلك﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb's annexation to it; ﴿قلتم﴾ is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿إذا﴾; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, accusative and futurity; ﴿يبعث﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; the Divine Name is the fāʿil; ﴿من بعده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and ﴿رسولًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كذلك يضل الله من هو مسرف مرتاب﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an attribute of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يضل الله﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿مسرف مرتاب﴾ are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾; and the clause ﴿هو مسرف﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿الذين يجادلون في آيات الله بغير سلطان أتاهم﴾: ﴿الذين﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يجادلون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿في آيات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادل﴾, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿بغير﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil; ﴿سلطان﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أتاهم﴾ is a past verb, ﴿هم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); and the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سلطان﴾; and the clause ﴿يجادلون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿كبر مقتا عند الله وعند الذين آمنوا﴾: ﴿كبر﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil is omitted, indicated by the context, i.e. "their disputing is grievous"; ﴿مقتا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa; ﴿عند﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), attached to ﴿مقتا﴾, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عند الذين آمنوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿عند الله﴾; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾, consisting of the verb and the fāʿil, is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿كبر...﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun.
﴿كذلك يطبع الله على كل قلب متكبر جبار﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an attribute of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) whose governor is ﴿يطبع﴾; ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يطبع الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿على كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يطبع﴾; ﴿قلب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿متكبر﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿جبار﴾ is a genitive naʿt.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وقال فرعون يا هامان ابن لي صرحا لعلي أبلغ الأسباب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال فرعون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿هامان﴾ is a singular munādā (one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; ﴿ابن﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: anta, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) of Pharaoh's saying; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) or to ﴿ابن﴾; ﴿صرحًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لعل﴾ is an abrogating particle of hope (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun); ﴿أبلغ الأسباب﴾ is a past verb and mafʿūl bihi «[Translator's note: so in the source; ﴿أبلغ﴾ is in fact an imperfect verb (fiʿl muḍāriʿ), nominative, with a latent fāʿil (anā).]», and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿أسباب السماوات فأطلع إلى إله موسى وإني لأظنه كاذبا﴾: ﴿أسباب السماوات﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿الأسباب﴾ in the previous verse, a badal of the whole for the whole; ﴿فأطلع﴾: the fāʾ is the causal fāʾ (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and ﴿أطلع﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the causal fāʾ, as an answer to the command ﴿ابنِ﴾ in the previous verse; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar (verbal noun) understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "Let there be building from you, and then looking from me"; ﴿إلى إله موسى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أطلع﴾; ﴿وإني﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿أظنه﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿كاذبًا﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿وكذلك زين لفرعون سوء عمله وصد عن السبيل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an attribute of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "with an adorning like that, the evil of his deed was made attractive to Pharaoh"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿زين﴾ is a passive past verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); ﴿لفرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زين﴾; ﴿سوء عمله﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿صد﴾ is a passive past verb, conjoined to ﴿زين﴾; and ﴿عن السبيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿صد﴾.
﴿وما كيد فرعون إلا في تباب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كيد فرعون﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿في تباب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿كيد﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وقال الذي آمن يا قوم اتبعون أهدكم سبيل الرشاد﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿قال الذي﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿آمن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿قوم﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿اتبعون﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أهدكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: anā, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿سبيل الرشاد﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿يا قوم إنما هذه الحياة الدنيا متاع وإن الآخرة هي دار القرار﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿قوم﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿إنما﴾ is a restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; ﴿هذه﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الحياة﴾ is a badal (substitute); ﴿الدنيا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective); ﴿متاع﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); ﴿الآخرة﴾ is its ism (noun); ﴿هي﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿دار القرار﴾ is the khabar of inna; or ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿دار القرار﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هي﴾, and the clause is the khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿من عمل سيئة فلا يجزى إلا مثلها﴾: ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عمل﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿سيئة﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يجزى﴾ is a passive imperfect verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: huwa; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿مثلها﴾ is the second object of ﴿يجزى﴾.
﴿ومن عمل صالحا من ذكر أو أنثى وهو مؤمن﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿من﴾ is conditional, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; ﴿عمل﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent; ﴿صالحًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿عمل﴾, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the attribute of the maṣdar, i.e. "does a righteous deed"; ﴿من ذكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿أو أنثى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من ذكر﴾; ﴿وهو مؤمن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿مؤمن﴾ a khabar (predicate), and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فأولئك يدخلون الجنة يرزقون فيها بغير حساب﴾: the fāʾ is linking; ﴿أولئك﴾ is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يدخلون الجنة﴾ is the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾, and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿يرزقون﴾ is a ḥāl, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and ﴿بغير﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "they are provided an ample provision without reckoning or liability."

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿إذ الأغلال في أعناقهم والسلاسل يسحبون﴾: إذ: a ẓarf (adverb) of past time, here intended for the future, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يعلمون﴾ in the previous ayah; or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). الأغلال: mubtadaʾ (subject). في أعناقهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿الأغلال في أعناقهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. والسلاسل: there are three views on its i'rab:
The first: it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الأغلال, and the preposition phrase serves as the predicate of both kinds, so the preposition phrase is intended to come later. The implied form is: إذ الأغلال والسلاسل في أعناقهم.
The second: it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted because the khabar of the first indicates it. On both of the preceding views, the clause ﴿يسحبون﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿أعناقهم﴾, or it is resumptive with no grammatical position.
The third: it is also a mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is the clause ﴿يسحبون﴾. There must be a reference in that clause returning to it; the implied form is: والسلاسل يسحبون بها. It was omitted because of the strong indication of it. On this view the clause ﴿يسحبون﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿في الحميم ثم في النار يسجرون﴾: في الحميم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يسحبون﴾. ثم: a conjunction denoting delay. وفي النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسجرون﴾. ويسجرون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿ثم قيل لهم أين ما كنتم تشركون﴾: ثم: a conjunction. وقيل: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قيل﴾. وأين: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place [Translator's note: the source reads «على الظرفين المكانية», apparently a slip for «على الظرفية المكانية»], and the adverb is attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). وما: a relative noun, delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). وكنتم: كان is a deficient past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿تشركون﴾ is the khabar of كان; تشركون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). The clause of the quoted speech ﴿أين ...﴾ is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿من دون الله قالوا ضلوا عنا﴾: من دون: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تشركون﴾ in the previous ayah; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وقالوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). وضلوا: a verb and its fāʿil. وعنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ضل﴾. The clause ﴿ضلوا عنا﴾ is the quoted speech.
﴿بل لم نكن ندعو من قبل شيئا كذلك يضل الله الكافرين﴾: بل: a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī). ولم: a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive. ونكن: a deficient imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن", and the clause ﴿ندعو﴾ is its khabar (predicate). وندعو: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; in ندعو the wāw is the final radical, and the fāʿil is a latent "نحن"]. ومن قبل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. وشيئًا: mafʿūl bihi. وكذلك: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar; and ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. و﴿يضل الله الكافرين﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ذلكم بما كنتم تفرحون في الأرض بغير الحق﴾: ذلكم: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject). وبما: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. وكنتم: كان is a deficient past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿تفرحون﴾ is the khabar of كان; تفرحون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). وفي الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تفرحون﴾. وبغير: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الحق: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وبما كنتم تمرحون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وبما: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. Or ما is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. وكنتم: كان is a deficient past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿تمرحون﴾ is the khabar of كان; تمرحون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿ادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها فبئس مثوى المتكبرين﴾: ادخلوا: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the clause is the quoted speech of an omitted verb of saying. وأبواب: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); وجهنم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وخالدين: ḥāl (circumstantial). وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿خالدين﴾. The fāʾ is a conjunction. وبئس: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame. ومثوى: the fāʿil of بئس; والمتكبرين: muḍāf ilayhi. The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being: هي.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فاصبر إن وعد الله حق﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. واصبر: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ووعد: its noun; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); وحق: the khabar (predicate) of إن. The clause ﴿فاصبر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم أو نتوفينك فإلينا يرجعون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is the conditional particle assimilated into the connective (ṣila) ما. ونرينك: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وبعض: second mafʿūl bihi. والذي: a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ونعدهم: an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿نعدهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. ﴿أو نتوفينك﴾: أو is a conjunction; نتوفينك: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive; its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. The fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa). وإلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يرجعون﴾. ويرجعون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is in the position of nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هم. The nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the second condition, namely ﴿نتوفينك﴾; the apodosis of the first condition is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿فذاك أمر بيِّن﴾ (then that is a clear matter). The conditional sentence is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا رسلا من قبلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿أرسلنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is fāʿil (agent). ﴿رسلا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿من قبلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رسلا﴾, or attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿ولقد أرسلنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿منهم من قصصنا عليك ومنهم من لم نقصص عليك﴾: ﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قصصنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is fāʿil; the clause ﴿قصصنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿عليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قصصنا﴾. The clause ﴿منهم من قصصنا﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿رسلا﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿ومنهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to past meaning). ﴿نقصص﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن". The clause ﴿لم نقصص﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿عليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نقصص﴾. The clause ﴿منهم من لم نقصص عليك﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿منهم من قصصنا عليك﴾.
﴿وما كان لرسول أن يأتي بآية إلا بإذن الله﴾: ﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is negative. ﴿كان﴾: a deficient past verb. ﴿لرسول﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of كان. ﴿أن يأتي﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and ﴿يأتي﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هو". The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يأتي﴾ is the delayed noun of كان. ﴿بآية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتي﴾. ﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بإذن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿ما كان لرسول...﴾ is conjoined to the one before it.
﴿فإذا جاء أمر الله قضي بالحق وخسر هنالك المبطلون﴾: ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿إذا﴾ is a future ẓarf (adverb) containing the meaning of condition, attached to ﴿قضي﴾. ﴿جاء﴾: a past verb. ﴿أمر﴾: fāʿil. ﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿جاء أمر الله﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. ﴿قضي﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the matter (الأمرُ). ﴿بالحق﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil. The clause ﴿قضي بالحق﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وخسر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿خسر﴾ is a past verb. ﴿هنالك﴾: ﴿هنا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to ﴿خسر﴾; the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿المبطلون﴾: the fāʿil of خسر. The clause ﴿خسر هنالك المبطلون﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿قضي بالحق﴾.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿الله الذي جعل لكم الأنعام لتركبوا منها ومنها تأكلون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. ﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿جعل﴾: a past verb meaning "created"; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿جعل﴾. ﴿الأنعام﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿جعل لكم الأنعام﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. ﴿لتركبوا﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl), and ﴿تركبوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the wāw of the plural is fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām of reason, and the lām of reason with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿جعل﴾. ﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an implied object of the verb ﴿تركبوا﴾, i.e. "that you may ride some of them" (لتركبوا بعضا منها); ﴿من﴾ is partitive. ﴿ومنها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of an implied object of the verb ﴿تأكلون﴾, i.e. "and you eat some of them" (وتأكلون بعضا منها); ﴿من﴾ is partitive. The clause ﴿منها تأكلون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لتركبوا منها﴾ according to the meaning, for the words of the Exalted ﴿لتركبوا منها﴾ have the meaning of ﴿منها تركبون﴾, or His words ﴿منها تأكلون﴾ have the meaning of ﴿لتأكلوا منها﴾.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿ولكم فيها منافع ولتبلغوا عليها حاجة في صدوركم﴾: ﴿ولكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿منافع﴾. ﴿منافع﴾: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). The words ﴿ولكم فيها منافع﴾ are also conjoined according to the meaning, i.e. "and that you may benefit from benefits in them" (ولتنتفعوا بمنافع فيها). ﴿ولتبلغوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is for giving the reason, and ﴿تبلغوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the wāw of the plural is fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb ﴿تبلغوا﴾ is genitive by the lām of reason, and the lām of reason with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿جعل﴾ in the previous ayah. ﴿عليها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil in ﴿تبلغوا﴾. ﴿حاجة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿في صدوركم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حاجة﴾. The clause ﴿لتبلغوا﴾ is also conjoined to ﴿لتركبوا﴾.
﴿وعليها وعلى الفلك تحملون﴾: ﴿وعليها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿عليها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحملون﴾. ﴿وعلى الفلك﴾: conjoined to His words ﴿وعليها﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿على الفلك﴾ are attached to ﴿تحملون﴾. ﴿تحملون﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw of the plural is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿ويا قوم ما لي أدعوكم إلى النجاة وتدعونني إلى النار﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; يا: a vocative particle; قوم: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ما: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); لي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿أدعوكم﴾: an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أدعوكم﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إلى النجاة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أدعوكم﴾; تدعونني: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; إلى النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تدعون﴾; and the clause ﴿تدعونني﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from something implied (muqaddar), i.e. "and what is the matter with you that you call me", and the implied clause is conjoined to ﴿ما لي﴾.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿تدعونني لأكفر بالله وأشرك به ما ليس لي به علم﴾: the clause ﴿تدعونني﴾ is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from the first clause ﴿تدعونني﴾; ﴿لأكفر﴾: the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl), and أكفر is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the causal lām, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: anā; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدعونني﴾; بالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أكفر﴾; ﴿أشرك﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and أشرك is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشرك﴾; ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ليس لي به علم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ليس: an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); لي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علم﴾; and علم: the postponed ism (noun) of laysa.
﴿وأنا أدعوكم إلى العزيز الغفار﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أنا: the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أدعوكم﴾: a verb with a latent fāʿil, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أدعوكم﴾ is the khabar; إلى العزيز: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أدعوكم﴾; and الغفار: a genitive naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿لا جرم أنما تدعونني إليه ليس له دعوة في الدنيا ولا في الآخرة﴾: لا is negating, and جرم is a past verb, and anna together with what falls within its scope is the fāʿil (agent) of jarama; أن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿ما﴾ is its ism (noun); by right it should be written separately, because mā is a relative noun meaning alladhī, but it was written joined, following the practice (sunna) of the Muṣḥaf's orthography; تدعونني: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تدعونني﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدعونني﴾; the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of anna; ليس: an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); له: the fronted khabar of laysa; دعوة: its postponed ism; and في الدنيا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of daʿwa. ﴿ولا في الآخرة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, ﴿لا﴾ is connective (ṣila) to emphasize the negation, and في الآخرة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of daʿwa.
﴿وأن مردنا إلى الله وأن المسرفين هم أصحاب النار﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أن is an abrogating particle, and مردنا is its ism; إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of inna. ﴿وأن المسرفين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أن is an abrogating particle, and المسرفين is its ism; هم: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a mubtadaʾ (subject); أصحاب: the khabar of anna, or the khabar of hum, and the clause is the khabar of anna; and النار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿فستذكرون ما أقول لكم وأفوض أمري إلى الله﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; the sīn is a particle of futurity; تذكرون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ما: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أقول: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿أقول﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقول﴾; وأفوض: the wāw is conjunctive, and أفوض is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent; أمري: the mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أفوض﴾.
﴿إن الله بصير بالعباد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the Divine Name is its ism (noun), and بصير is its khabar (predicate); and بالعباد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بصير﴾.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فوقاه الله سيئات ما مكروا وحاق بآل فرعون سوء العذاب﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to something omitted that the context requires, i.e. "When they threatened him with killing and sought him but were unable to get him, Allah protected him." ﴿وقاه الله﴾: a past verb, a fronted first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); سيئات: a second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); ما: a relative, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿مكروا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause ﴿مكروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or mā is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), so that it together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a genitive muḍāf ilayhi; حاق: a past verb; بآل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حاق﴾; فرعون: muḍāf ilayhi; سوء: the fāʿil; and العذاب: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿النار يعرضون عليها غدوا وعشيا﴾: النار: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. hiya; or it is parsed as a badal (substitute) from sūʾ al-ʿadhāb; on these two views the clause ﴿يعرضون﴾ is parsed as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or ﴿النار﴾ is parsed as a mubtadaʾ and the clause ﴿يعرضون﴾ as the khabar; عليها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعرضون﴾; غدوًّا: an adverb (ẓarf), attached to ﴿يعرضون﴾; and عشيا: conjoined to ﴿غدوا﴾.
﴿ويوم تقوم الساعة أدخلوا آل فرعون أشد العذاب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; يوم: an adverb, attached to an omitted saying, i.e. "Allah will say on the Day the Hour is established"; ﴿تقوم الساعة﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿تقوم الساعة﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); أدخلوا: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; آل: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فرعون: muḍāf ilayhi; أشد: a second mafʿūl bihi, by making ﴿أدخلوا﴾ include (taḍmīn) the sense of "make them taste"; العذاب: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿أدخلوا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) of an implied saying.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿وإذ يتحاجون في النار فيقول الضعفاء للذين استكبروا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذ: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "Mention, O Muhammad, to your people." يتحاجون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يتحاجون﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); في النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتحاجون﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿يقول الضعفاء﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; للذين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقول﴾; استكبروا: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا كنا لكم تبعا فهل أنتم مغنون عنا نصيبا من النار﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun); the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); kāna is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿تبعًا﴾, or attached to it if it is considered a maṣdar (verbal noun); تبعا is the khabar of kāna; the clause ﴿كنا لكم تبعا﴾ is the khabar of inna; and the clause ﴿إن﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); ﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and هل is an interrogative particle; أنتم: the mubtadaʾ (subject); مغنون: its khabar; عنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مغنون﴾; نصيبًا: the object of ﴿مغنون﴾; and من النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute of ﴿نصيبًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿قال الذين استكبروا إنا كل فيها﴾: قال الذين: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); استكبروا: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. إنا: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun); كل: a mubtadaʾ (subject), which may begin the clause because of the sense of generality in it; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of kull; and the clause is the khabar of inna.
﴿إن الله قد حكم بين العباد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the Divine Name is its ism; قد: a particle of realization (taḥqīq); حكم: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿قد حكم﴾ is the khabar of inna; بين: an adverb (ẓarf), attached to ﴿حكم﴾; and العباد: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وقال الذين في النار لخزنة جهنم ادعوا ربكم يخفف عنا يوما من العذاب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال الذين﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). في النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of alladhīna, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. لخزنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; جهنم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ادعوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ربكم: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); يخفف: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); عنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخفف﴾; يومًا: an adverb (ẓarf), also attached to ﴿يخفف﴾; and من العذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute of an omitted word which is the object of yukhaffif, i.e. "that He lighten for us something of the punishment for a day."

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿قالوا أولم تك تأتيكم رسلكم بالبينات﴾: قالوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the pronoun refers to the keepers of Hell; the hamza is interrogative; the wāw is conjunctive; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; تك: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was dropped for lightening, and the ism (noun) of tak is latent (mustatir); تأتيكم: an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تأتيكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); رسلكم: the fāʿil of taʾtīkum; both tak and taʾtīkum contend for it (tanāzuʿ), so it was given as fāʿil to the second, and a pronoun was implied in the first. بالبينات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تأتيكم﴾.
﴿قالوا بلى﴾: قالوا: a verb and its fāʿil; and بلى: a particle of answer.
﴿قالوا فادعوا﴾: قالوا: a verb and its fāʿil; فادعوا: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and ادعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿وما دعاء الكافرين إلا في ضلال﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negating; دعاء: the mubtadaʾ (subject); الكافرين: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and في ضلال: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of duʿāʾ.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿ويريكم آياته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يريكم﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the plural. ﴿آياته﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يريكم﴾, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿يريكم آياته﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿جعل لكم الأنعام﴾.
﴿فأي آيات الله تنكرون﴾: ﴿فأي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿أي﴾ is an interrogative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تنكرون﴾; it is necessarily fronted because interrogative nouns take the head of the sentence. The interrogative is for rebuke. ﴿آيات الله﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the word آيات is put in construct with the Name of Majesty, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تنكرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is fāʿil. The clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿يريكم آياته﴾.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿أفلم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. ﴿أفلم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation; the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e. "Did they sit still and not travel?" (أقعدوا فلم يسيروا); ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to past meaning). ﴿يسيروا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw of the plural is fāʿil (agent). ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يسيروا﴾. ﴿فينظروا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining it to ﴿يسيروا﴾, or causal (sababiyya); ﴿ينظروا﴾ is an imperfect verb, either jussive by being conjoined to ﴿يسيروا﴾, or accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding words, the implied form being: "Was there not from them a travelling and then a looking?" (أفلم يكن منهم سير فنظر؟); and the wāw of the plural is fāʿil. ﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كان﴾: an abrogating verb. ﴿عاقبة﴾: the delayed noun of كان. الذين: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿من قبلهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the verb ﴿ينظروا﴾.
